messages:
Lina (product): quick sync — two enterprise pilots asked for: (1) rolling upgrades that preserve tenant egress IP, (2) a migration lane from our full bundle to a slim agent that assumes customer-managed NAT. Need scope + launch criteria.
Matt (eng): core risks: model-serving drain + KV cache continuity. Two technical lanes: operator-driven rollout (preferred for canary/rollback) or sidecar replace (faster but riskier).
Sarah (netops): egress preservation is deal-blocking for some customers. Recommend supporting customer-managed NAT (primary) and our relay as fallback. Docs must cover BGP peering + static-route fallback.
Jill (devops): packaging plan: installer presets = full, slim, airgap. Slim will include a post-install `--force-ip-check` and a `preserve_egress` flag. Need CI smoke tests for slim install.
Lina (product): draft launch criteria: 1) rolling upgrade with no >1min p99 latency spike; 2) pinned tenants keep identical egress IPs during rollout; 3) slim installer validated in >=2 field pilots; 4) canary + rollback runbook published.
Matt (eng): test plan: harness simulating ~100 tenants with pinned IPs. Rollout path: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Add `/health/upgrade-ready` endpoint for drain readiness.
Sarah (netops): include BGP snippet in runbook: `neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65000`. Add iptables fallback example and validation commands.
Jill (devops): rough effort: operator + canary infra ~4 sprints (2 engs), packaging ~1 sprint (1 eng), netops docs/tests ~0.5 sprint, plus 2 weeks field validation.
Lina (product): owners: @Matt PRD + canary plan by Tue; @Jill slim flags + ip-check script by Fri; @Sarah egress runbook by Thu; @ops-bot create tracking ticket. Any objections?
Matt (eng): ack, starting PRD stub.
Jill (devops): prototyping ip-check tomorrow.
Sarah (netops): pulling customer configs for examples.
ops-bot: created ticket RDW-6120 "private-deploy: rolling upgrade + egress-preserve" assigned to Lina, Matt, Jill, Sarah. :white_check_mark:
Lina (product): thanks all — i'll add estimates to roadmap and ping legal for SLA language. Scheduling 30-min walkthrough next Mon.
